notes.title: Tactical RPG The Protagonist: EX-1 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Experience tactical combat in this intense sci-fi RPG. After a constructive Early Access campaign, 3Mind Games’ The Protagonist: EX-1 has had a full release on Steam. With a gripping story of survival behind enemy lines, use strategy and unique hand-to-hand combat mechanics to escape your extraterrestrial prison. The fate of Terra is in your hands!

Watch the Protagonist: EX-1 trailer here: https://youtu.be/xlPiuT7zSkg

The Protagonist EX-1 combines RPG and turn-based strategy elements with a gripping science fiction story to keep players entertained for hours. Personalise your campaign as you control Angel and the squad, customising their close-combat abilities and navigating through dynamic dialogue trees, where decisions can have drastic consequences! With characters voiced by an impressive cast, including Hollywood actors Temuera Morrison and Tony Todd, delve into a narrative of war, mystery and extra-terrestrial action as you defeat menacing alien foes and control the fate of the world below you.

[b]Full release notes: [/b]

- All Playable Characters (10+)
- All Playable Areas 
- Bugs fixes

notes.title: Demo available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36023558/a1070dc54a62c2ed3f97c836d1680b4e6e32adc0.jpg[/img]

For the first time ever, a demo for The Protagonist: EX-1, a sci-fi, turn-based, tactical RPG, is available as part of the Steam Game Festival Autumn Edition. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1418950/

The demo consists of approximately 30 minutes of gameplay during which you’ll be able to go hand-to-hand against invading aliens using the game’s extremely intuitive Martial Arts Combat System through the first level of the game. It will also include some story-rich cut scenes. 

The demo will be available throughout the Steam Game Festival, from October 7-13. Play the demo today and fight to save your team trapped aboard a mysterious invading space station!

notes.title: The Protagonist: EX-1 announced
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36023558/53d46d19c1d7796bd9e8d52f6c8979807dadbcff.jpg[/img]

[i]A sabotage mission in space goes very wrong…[/i]

Uncover the truth:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3yqOiB46oqQ

Coming to Steam in 2020, The Protagonist: EX-1 is a narrative turn-based tactical RPG which takes place in a brewing war between the planet Terra and an invading synthetic race. Become Angel, a highly trained special agent with expertise in both the sciences and martial combat, who is sent to neutralize the alien threat.

Experience tactical fights and a gripping story that will engage you for hours while you search for your lost team members. 

[h1][b]Features:[/b][/h1][list]
[*] [b]M.A.C.S. or Martial Arts Combat System[/b] – Customize your character’s close-combat abilities, experiment with, and perfect their combat style
[*] [b]Dynamic Dialogue System (D.D.S.)[/b] - Make decisions which have consequences and can drastically change the reactions and responses from other characters. Pay attention to what you say or be in for a surprise!
[*] [b]Initiative and Action Points System (I.A.P.S.)[/b] - Take full control over the actions your characters take on their turn.
[*] [b]Deep content[/b] – Enjoy more than 7 playable characters, over 10 types of enemies, 19+ weapon types and much more!
[*] [b]Engaging stylistics[/b] – Experience an isometric top-down view and hyper-realistic graphics.
[/list]
Winning a war is tough with no memory and no team. You need determination. You need luck. You need a Protagonist.
